title: Closing remarks and recording details
summary: Interviewer states the tape was made at the daughter's bar on November 3, 1960 by Bill Russell and Ralph Collins; the rest has no speech.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: No, I don't remember the details of that. It's not that important to worry about. But I just thought we might, I thought if you had some old material in the scrapbooks we might have come across something there but it wasn't in this book of course. Well I think we'll turn it off and rewind. I might add on here though that we made this tape over at your daughter's bar room at the corner of Robertson and Ursuline and the date is November the 3rd, 1960. And in addition to Mr. Piquet, this is Bill Russell and Ralph Collins doing the interview. We do this in order to, when they transcribe it up at Tulane they know just who was here and the date that we talked to. Good. Good stuff Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you.
